title: Software Engineering Intern - Summer 2025
eligibility: Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD degree in Computer Science or related STEM field.
qualification: Pursuing a CS degree, proficiency in C++, C#, Java, or Python
description: Work alongside full-time engineers on scalable, high-impact features within Azure, Developer Tools, or Windows applications.

title: Gates Cambridge Scholarship 2025
eligibility: International students outside the UK applying to undertake a full-time postgraduate degree at the University of Cambridge.
salary: Fully Funded (University fees, £20,000 maintenance allowance, travel)
qualification: Outstanding academic achievement, leadership potential, commitment to improving lives
description: Fully funded postgraduate scholarships for outstanding applicants from countries outside the UK to pursue a degree at the University of Cambridge.

title: Junior Remote Frontend Developer
eligibility: Open to candidates worldwide with working authorization in their country of residence.
qualification: 1+ years experience with Vue.js or React, HTML/CSS, Git version control
description: Develop scalable web interfaces and contribute to open-source UI libraries for the GitLab DevOps platform.

title: Associate Product Manager
eligibility: Recent graduates or early career professionals with up to 2 years of product management/technical experience.
qualification: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical technical experience
description: Drive product strategy and work across engineering, design, and business teams to launch user-facing products.

title: Microsoft Imagine Cup 2025
eligibility: Students aged 16+ enrolled in a high school or higher education institution worldwide.
qualification: Team of 1-4 students building an innovative technology solution leveraging Microsoft Azure AI
description: Global student technology competition focusing on building solutions using AI to solve pressing global challenges.

title: CS50: Introduction to Computer Science
eligibility: Open to anyone worldwide with internet access.
description: An entry-level course teaching students how to think algorithmically and solve problems efficiently using C, Python, SQL, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
